projects.title: Novatra
projects.description: Novatra offers topic-wise quizzes, past papers, analytics, and detailed explanations to help students prepare for NSE, JEE, NEET, and other exams.  It provides a focused study environment and progress tracking.

projects.title: Repo Recommendations
projects.description: Generate GitHub repository recommendations based on your starred repositories and co-stargazers.

projects.title: Link Classification
projects.description: Generate structured metadata for a list of URLs. The pipeline reads links.md, fetches page content, classifies each link, and writes results to JSON.

projects.title: Tidy Tabs Chrome
projects.description: AI-powered browser tab organization using Google's Gemini API to intelligently group your tabs by topic, domain, and context.

projects.title: Steam Wrapped
projects.description: Steam Wrapped is a web application that delivers a personalized "Wrapped" experience for Steam users, similar to Spotify Wrapped but focused on gaming data.
